name: Swallow
description:
The monstrosity makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the monstrosity, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the monstrosity's turns. A monstrosity can have only one creature swallowed at a time.
If the monstrosity takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the monstrosity must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 ft. of the monstrosity. If the monstrosity dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 15 ft. of movement, exiting prone.
